summary: Iteration 4 backend testing complete. Added TestChat (6 tests: victim send + decrypt roundtrip, empty text 400, 404 for non-existent case on POST and GET, cross-victim 403 on POST and GET, DB Fernet 'gAAAAA' prefix validation, counsellor+victim bidirectional chat with chronological ordering) and TestImpact (4 tests: counsellor 403, supervisor shape with all required fields and 4 svi buckets Low/Moderate/High/Critical, days param honored for daily length, escalation count reflected). Updated TestSupport to validate lat/lng fields on each entry (India bounding box) and relaxed strict count to >=6 since directory grew to 10. Full suite 48/48 passed (previous 38 regression + 10 new) in 5.52s with pytest-xdist. Encrypted-at-rest verified via direct MongoDB read: chat_messages.text_encrypted starts with Fernet prefix 'gAAAAA' and never equals plaintext.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~994 lines — well past the 700-line split threshold. Strongly recommend extracting auth, cases, chat, counsellor/supervisor, push, attachments, export, and support directory into separate routers; current monolith hurts maintainability.

Chat endpoint uses encrypt_audio/decrypt_audio despite its name — functionally correct (Fernet is bytes-agnostic), but misleading naming. Consider renaming to encrypt_blob/decrypt_blob or exposing a thin alias in crypto_util for text.

GET /cases/{id}/chat has no counsellor assignment check — any counsellor/supervisor can read any case's chat (mirrors existing audio/attachment behavior). Acceptable per prior iterations' note but worth gating behind assigned_counsellor_id or supervisor role.

Impact dashboard performs two full-collection scans on cases (lines 813 and 855) just to compute category counts; the first scan already projects fields but omits 'category'. Merge into a single query with 'category' included to halve DB round-trips.

Impact dashboard loads up to 2000 cases and 2000 escalations into memory — fine for MVP, but should migrate to Mongo aggregation pipeline ($match on created_at, $group by date/level/category) once dataset grows.

Chat 'author_name' falls back to email when name is empty — in current seed the victim has name 'Demo Victim' but newly auto-registered victims have empty names, so chat shows raw email which may leak PII in UI; consider masked_phone fallback.
No pagination on GET /cases/{id}/chat (hard limit 500). Fine for MVP but add skip/limit params before production.
Push notification on chat_send only fires victim->counsellor direction (not counsellor->victim) — consistent with 'victims not subscribed yet', but comment that out clearly or remove dead branch.
avg_time_to_escalation_min correctly returns null when no escalations in window (confirmed by test); good handling of empty-list division.
test_credentials: DEV MODE OTPs returned by /api/auth/request-otp and /api/counsellor/request-otp. Seeded: priya.counsellor@samvedna.in (counsellor), verma.supervisor@samvedna.in (supervisor), victim.demo@samvedna.in (victim).
seed_data_creation: Used idempotent /api/seed. Chat & impact tests create fresh cases per test; cross-victim tests register ephemeral TEST_ victims via /auth flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has TestChat and TestImpact classes in addition to prior Seed/Auth/SVI/Cases/Counsellor/Supervisor/Support/Audio/Push/Attachments/Export/AuditEntries. TestSupport switched from count==6 to >=6 with lat/lng India-bbox validation (current directory = 10 entries). Chat Fernet verification uses direct pymongo read from backend/.env. If server adds counsellor-assignment restriction to GET chat, test_counsellor_and_victim_both_chat will need the counsellor to patch accept before reading (already does).
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions or new bugs.
